resources.string: Fixed self-tests check offline parse structure only. They do not access websites or establish website compatibility.

Structural quarantine records consecutive parsing anomalies for this package/environment combination, not proof of malicious or damaged code. Explicit rejection and fixed self-test failure have separate reasons.
These are bounded local thresholds, not statistical health guarantees. Stable versions are not continuously monitored; network failures alone do not establish a bad package.

Recovery uses only currently authorized candidate rejection or rollback. Signed-package high-water marks, policy versions, safety floors and accumulated revocations are retained; authorization may remain disabled afterward.

Closing or backgrounding this page revokes its display and requests cancellation. Committed local transactions remain committed. Reopening rereads state; a second management task waits for the old operation to exit.
